meals.description: Crispy Prosciutto Date Pasta is a small-format pasta built from salty prosciutto, sweet dates, chilli, and glossy pasta and designed for an ordinary weeknight.

steps.name: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Bring a small pot of well-salted water to a boil. Cook the pasta until just firm and reserve at least 1/2 cup of its starchy water before draining.
